about: Modwerk source-only digistring packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/digistring.

mods.title: STRING
mods.summary: A Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine: bowed, hit, noise or plucked strings that go through the Digitakt's own AMP, filter, mixer and effects.
mods.description: A Karplus-Strong plucked string SRC machine: bowed, hit, noise or plucked strings that go through the Digitakt's own AMP, filter, mixer and effects.
mods.author: Alez22
mods.on_unit: The author tested 0.9.0 on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 (5 minutes) and 1.54 (15 minutes), with Core 2.1, Machine Pages, RAM Machines and Note Accumulator (2026-10-28): machine list, SRC page, defaults, LFO, save/reboot/reload, Note Accumulator and RAM Machines work; three STRING tracks play cleanly, from four the UI lags.
